  Scenario: C8 A consumed row that answers late is ended at its budget (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a consumed row stub that answers later than its 2 s budget
    When the round branch calls the row
    Then the call is ended at 2 s and the outcome is recorded as a timeout
    And the retry count is the one the contract declares, not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E4024-CON-AC5)

  Scenario: C9 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a status change that the model does not allow
    When the change is requested
    Then the request is refused with 422 and MSG-GEN-001 or MSG-S5-001
    And the status is not changed
